studies.label: Enhanced audio-tactile multisensory interaction in a peripersonal task after echolocation. (a)
studies.experimentLabel: Pre/post neck PPS assessment with echolocation and control groups

contracts.label: Auditory stimulus
contracts.value: Approaching white noise delivered by seven serial loudspeakers, controlled in MATLAB.
contracts.pageOrSection: Methods pp.856-859, Peripersonal space task; Procedure; Figure 1 p.857
contracts.evidenceNote: Exact source generation, transition envelope and sound level are unresolved; 53 dB is the vocal-response trigger threshold, not stimulus calibration.

renderer_apparatus.value: Seven custom serial loudspeakers.

source_mode.value: White noise through physical speakers; generated versus prerecorded source unresolved.

stimulus_identity_or_asset.value: White noise, 3000-ms approach.

contracts.label: Trajectory and kinematics
contracts.value: Seven speakers to the left of the head at head height: 119 to 17 cm over 3000 ms; 17-cm spacing, reported speed 34 cm/s.
contracts.pageOrSection: Methods pp.856-859, Peripersonal space task; Procedure; Figure 1 p.857
contracts.evidenceNote: Figure 1A pixels inspected. Exact metric Cartesian/azimuth layout and loudspeaker switching envelope are not recovered; do not substitute the frontal 34-cm training object.

coordinate_frame_body_anchor.value: Head-centred array on the left, at head elevation; touch on left neck.

motion_mode.value: Approach through ordered physical sources.

timing_constraint.value: 102-cm travel over 3 s, 34 cm/s.

contracts.label: Trial sequence
contracts.value: Randomly intermixed bimodal target, tactile-only baseline and auditory-only catch families.
contracts.pageOrSection: Methods pp.856-859, Peripersonal space task; Procedure; Figure 1 p.857

condition_intermixing.value: Three families randomized within the assessment.

ordered_elements_and_source_selection.value: Bimodal: approaching white noise with one neck vibration at a speaker position. Baseline: neck vibration outside the nominal sound interval. Catch: sound without touch.

trial_families.value: 84 bimodal,28 tactile-only and 28 auditory-only catches per PPS assessment.

within_trial_timing_or_placement.value: Seven bimodal positions; baseline 500 ms before onset or 500 ms after offset.

contracts.label: Task and response
contracts.value: Say TAH promptly to neck vibration, withhold on auditory-only catches; microphone trigger at 53 dB.
contracts.pageOrSection: Methods pp.856-859, Peripersonal space task; Procedure; Figure 1 p.857
contracts.evidenceNote: No PPS response deadline is reported. The 20-s allowance belongs to echolocation training; the printed RT subtraction order is retained as a conflict rather than silently corrected.

response_mapping_or_expected_action.value: Say TAH as quickly as possible.

response_mode_or_device.value: Vocal response recorded by microphone with 53-dB threshold.

scoring_rule.value: Printed Methods subtract vocal-trigger time from tactile time, opposite to conventional positive RT; raw scoring sign remains unresolved.

target_and_nontarget_rule.value: Respond to touch; ignore sound; withhold on no-touch catches.

contracts.label: Jitter and ITI policy
contracts.value: Each PPS trial is started by the experimenter; no fixed intertrial interval.
contracts.pageOrSection: Methods pp.856-859, Peripersonal space task; Procedure; Figure 1 p.857
contracts.evidenceNote: A manual start is a reported policy, not missing numerical jitter. Timing distributions from the separate TIME training must not be imported.

policy_type.value: manual_or_event_driven

timing_scope_and_anchor.value: Experimenter initiates the next trial.

values_or_range.value: No numeric ITI: explicitly not fixed.

contracts.label: SOA schedule
contracts.value: Onset-relative tactile times 0,500,1000,1500,2000,2500,3000 ms map respectively to 119,102,85,68,51,34,17 cm.
contracts.pageOrSection: Methods pp.856-859, Peripersonal space task; Procedure; Figure 1 p.857
contracts.derivationNote: Time at distance d is (119-d)/34 seconds;17/34 =0.5 s between adjacent positions. Figure 1A confirms the endpoint anchors.

direction_specific_pairing.value: Approach only; Figure 1A locates onset at D 1 and offset at D 7.

ordered_soa_values_or_derivable_distance.value: Seven positions from 119 to 17 cm, separated by 17 cm at 34 cm/s.

reference_event_and_sign.value: Auditory onset at farthest speaker; positive values delay tactile stimulation.

contracts.label: Tactile target
contracts.value: 20-ms vibration from an 18 mm² custom motor on the left side of the neck.
contracts.pageOrSection: Methods pp.856-859, Peripersonal space task; Procedure; Figure 1 p.857
contracts.evidenceNote: Motor surface area does not establish vibration amplitude or calibration.

body_site_and_side.value: Left neck.

modality.value: Vibrotactile motor.

contracts.pageOrSection: Methods pp.856-859, Peripersonal space task; Procedure; Figure 1 p.857
contracts.evidenceNote: Do not assume 14 at each endpoint.
contracts.derivationNote: 3000-ms sound duration +500-ms post-offset delay =+3500 ms onset-relative.

family_or_explicit_none.value: Tactile-only controls outside the sound interval.

resolved_trial_count.value: 28 total per assessment.

contracts.label: Auditory stimulus
contracts.value: 1000-ms pink-noise probe distributed over four successive loudspeakers using cosine windows, with 10-ms onset/offset ramps.
contracts.pageOrSection: Methods, manuscript pp. 7-10 (PDF pp. 8-11); Figure 1 p. 8

stimulus_identity_or_asset.value: Physical Aura Sound NSW1-205-A loudspeakers, Octave 6.2.0/Playrec, RME MADIface USB and Innosonix MA32/LP; nearest speaker reference 70 dB measured at head centre in participant absence.

contracts.label: Trajectory and kinematics
contracts.value: Sequential crossfade over four physical speakers spans 48 cm in 1000 ms at stated 48 cm/s; front/rear blocks use three starting distances.
contracts.pageOrSection: Methods, manuscript pp. 7-10 (PDF pp. 8-11); Figure 1 p. 8
contracts.evidenceNote: Body orientation relative to the fixed apparatus distinguishes front/rear; maintain the head-distance versus chest tactile-site distinction.

motion_mode.value: Sequential physical-loudspeaker crossfade, not a literally moving loudspeaker.

timing_constraint.value: 1000-ms probe, reported 48 cm/s; sound burst/crossfade waveform is a separate incomplete contract.

contracts.label: Trial sequence
contracts.value: 500-ms 1000-Hz warning tone, stated one-second cue interval, then 1000-ms approaching probe with optional chest touch.
contracts.pageOrSection: Methods, manuscript pp. 7-10 (PDF pp. 8-11); Figure 1 p. 8
contracts.evidenceNote: The exact onset-versus-offset anchor of the one-second cue interval is unresolved; do not silently add an extra 500 ms or equate warning onset with probe onset.

trial_families.value: Probe+touch, probe-absent matched tactile baselines, probe-without-touch catches, and warning-only catches.

contracts.label: Task and response

contracts.label: Auditory stimulus
contracts.value: 3000-ms broadband noise, made to loom through intensity manipulation on two speakers.
contracts.pageOrSection: Section 2.2.3, journal pp. 60-61 (PDF pp. 5-6)
contracts.evidenceNote: Original file/generator, calibrated envelope and source mixing are unresolved; do not substitute an unqualified generic noise waveform.

stimulus_identity_or_asset.value: Dynamic broadband noise; sound duration 3 s; ExpyVR controls acoustic/tactile delivery.

contracts.label: Trajectory and kinematics
contracts.value: Near speaker at 0 cm from the tested hand and far speaker 100 cm away; intensity-based approach.
contracts.pageOrSection: Section 2.2.3, journal pp. 60-61 (PDF pp. 5-6)
contracts.evidenceNote: Main text describes a linear negative relationship between delay and perceived distance, but no reproducible envelope-to-distance calibration is given.

coordinate_frame_body_anchor.value: Tested left or right hand.

geometry.value: Near 0 cm and far 100 cm from the hand/near speaker.

motion_mode.value: gain_only_proxy

timing_constraint.value: 3000-ms sound.

contracts.label: Trial sequence
contracts.value: Looming sound with delayed hand vibration, silent tactile controls, or sound-only catches; trial types and delays randomized.
contracts.pageOrSection: Section 2.2.3, journal pp. 60-61 (PDF pp. 5-6)

ordered_elements_and_source_selection.value: Sound onset precedes delayed touch on bimodal trials; unimodal rows omit sound; catches omit touch. Both hand conditions are tested in randomized order.

trial_families.value: 20 targets per three delays, 10 silent controls per delay, 20 sound-only catches in the described recipe.

contracts.label: Task and response
contracts.value: Press a foot pedal with the right foot within 2000 ms from tactile onset; ignore looming sound.
contracts.pageOrSection: Section 2.2.3, journal pp. 60-61 (PDF pp. 5-6)
contracts.evidenceNote: Young/older group is a between-participant comparison, not a different response route.

response_mapping_or_expected_action.value: Right-foot press as quickly as possible.

response_mode_or_device.value: Foot pedal.

response_window_and_anchor.value: 2000 ms from tactile delivery.

target_and_nontarget_rule.value: Respond to hand vibration; auditory-only catch trials have no touch target.

contracts.label: Jitter and ITI policy
contracts.value: Inter-stimulus intervals randomly selected from 500,750,1000 ms; event anchor not stated.
contracts.pageOrSection: Section 2.2.3, journal pp. 60-61 (PDF pp. 5-6)
contracts.evidenceNote: Do not silently relabel an unspecified inter-stimulus interval as tactile-to-tactile, response-to-next-onset or sound-offset ITI.

policy_type.value: discrete_set

contracts.label: SOA schedule
contracts.value: Auditory-onset anchored +300,+1500,+2700 ms, labelled far/medium/near.
contracts.pageOrSection: Section 2.2.3, journal pp. 60-61 (PDF pp. 5-6)

reference_event_and_sign.value: Touch after sound onset is positive.

contracts.label: Tactile target
contracts.value: 100-ms vibration to the dorsum of the tested hand using a Precision MicroDrives 312-101 motor.
contracts.pageOrSection: Section 2.2.3, journal pp. 60-61 (PDF pp. 5-6)
contracts.evidenceNote: Reported motor specifications and pulse duration describe the authors apparatus; no replacement-actuator calibration is inferred.

body_site_and_side.value: Dorsum of the tested left or right hand.

modality.value: Shaftless vibration motor, model 312-101.

waveform_and_duration.value: 100 ms; device specifications 3 V, 60 mA, 9000 rpm, 150 Hz, 5 g.

contracts.label: Baseline/control trials
contracts.value: 30 silent controls in the described recipe: 10 at each nominal +300,+1500,+2700-ms delay.
contracts.pageOrSection: Section 2.2.3, journal pp. 60-61 (PDF pp. 5-6)
contracts.evidenceNote: Main Methods gives equivalent delays but does not define the silent-row zero trigger. The fastest mean unisensory RT is an analysis baseline selection, not a fourth trial family.

allocation_rule.value: 10 per each of three silent-condition delays.

family_or_explicit_none.value: tactile_only_soa_matched

resolved_trial_count.value: 30 per described recipe.

contracts.label: Catch/no-target trials
contracts.value: 20 sound-only catches in the described recipe; no tactile response target.
contracts.pageOrSection: Section 2.2.3, journal pp. 60-61 (PDF pp. 5-6)
contracts.evidenceNote: Whether the complete recipe is repeated separately for each hand is retained in the allocation gap.

allocation_rule.value: 20 catches per described recipe.

family_or_explicit_none.value: auditory_only_withhold

resolved_trial_count.value: 20 per described recipe.

target_role_and_expected_action.value: Withhold tactile detection response when vibration is absent.

contracts.label: Repetition allocation
contracts.value: Described recipe totals 110 rows: 20 x 3 targets + 10 x 3 controls + 20 catches; hand crossing is not explicit.
contracts.pageOrSection: Section 2.2.3, journal pp. 60-61 (PDF pp. 5-6)
contracts.evidenceNote: Do not automatically double to 220 without a declared interpretation of the hand factor; the current primary Methods describes both hands but leaves that count crossing implicit.

exceptions_or_overrides.value: Both hands tested; current Methods does not explicitly state whether the 110-row recipe is per hand or whole-session total.

factor_dimensions.value: Three delays x bimodal/unimodal family, catch family and both tested hands; young/older groups.

repetitions_or_exact_counts.value: 60 bimodal targets, 30 silent controls and 20 catches in the described recipe.

contracts.label: Block and order policy
contracts.value: Hand order randomized; PPS block count and block composition are not stated.
contracts.pageOrSection: Section 2.2.3, journal pp. 60-61 (PDF pp. 5-6)
contracts.evidenceNote: Five blocks in section 2.2.1 belong to body-landmark localization, not the PPS task. Subsequent sound localization is also a separate supporting task.

within_block_randomization.value: Delays and trial types randomized; left/right hand condition order randomized among participants.

studies.experimentLabel: Static near/far hand PPS with cane and handle conditions

contracts.label: Auditory stimulus
contracts.value: Stimulus type: Auditory stimuli were 150 ms bursts of white noise. | Source provenance: Sounds were generated by two identical loudspeakers; phono-spectral waves were recorded by computer to verify equal sounds at the origin. | Auditory conditions: Near versus far sound location was crossed with weak target, strong nontarget, and sound-only catch rows; tool state was manipulated in separate cane/handle/training blocks. | Gain envelope: Near and far sounds were equalized to 70 dB at the participant's ear; sounds were also checked for equality at origin. | Renderer or apparatus: Two identical loudspeakers placed near and far from the stimulated hand; XGen software controlled stimulus presentation and response recording.
contracts.pageOrSection: PDF p.3, Procedure and Materials | PDF pp.2-4, Procedure, Figure 1, and Results | PDF pp.2-3, Figure 1 and Procedure
contracts.evidenceNote: The sound class and duration are stated in the methods text. | The paper describes speaker generation and verification, but not the source file/noise seed. | Sound location and tool/training conditions are reported as design factors. | SPL equalization is reported; no detailed gain curve is needed for static bursts. | The apparatus and control software are described in the methods section.

contracts.label: Trajectory and kinematics
contracts.value: Trajectory path: Near sound was close to the stimulated right hand; far sound was on the floor about 125 cm from the hand, corresponding to average cane length and the fixed cane-tip location. | Stimulus duration: Auditory white-noise bursts lasted 150 ms. | Stimulus speed: No looming or moving auditory stimulus was used; near and far sounds were static speaker locations. | Trajectory count: Two static auditory positions/conditions: near the stimulated hand and far on the floor near the cane tip. | Gain envelope: Near and far sounds were equalized to 70 dB at the participant's ear; sounds were also checked for equality at origin. | Renderer or apparatus: Two identical loudspeakers placed near and far from the stimulated hand; XGen software controlled stimulus presentation and response recording.
contracts.pageOrSection: PDF pp.2-3, Procedure and Figure 1 | PDF p.3, Procedure and Materials | PDF pp.2-3, Figure 1 and Procedure
contracts.evidenceNote: The method and figure give the static spatial layout. | Duration is explicitly reported. | The task uses static near/far locations rather than a moving trajectory. | Near and far sound locations are the task's auditory spatial factor. | SPL equalization is reported; no detailed gain curve is needed for static bursts. | The apparatus and control software are described in the methods section.

contracts.label: Trial sequence
contracts.value: Weak tactile targets, strong tactile nontargets and sound-only catches paired with static near/far auditory locations.
contracts.pageOrSection: Methods / Procedure and Materials / Experimental design, PDF pp.2-3
contracts.evidenceNote: Normalized from existing primary PDF critical review dated 2026-06-16; no renewed PDF inspection. Respond only to weak tactile targets; strong tactile events are no-go, not additional response targets.

condition_intermixing.value: Near/far and trial families occur within each tool-condition task.

ordered_elements_and_source_selection.value: Weak and strong tactile events paired with near or far sound; no touch on sound-only catches.

trial_families.value: 60 weak tactile targets,60 strong tactile nontargets,30 sound-only catches per described task.

contracts.label: Task and response
contracts.value: Task sequence rules: Subjects verbally responded only to weak tactile targets, ignored sounds, received 30 familiarization trials before the experiment, and should not respond on strong nontarget or sound-only catch trials.

contracts.evidenceNote: Response rules and familiarization are reported. | Participants responded as rapidly as possible, but no numeric deadline or scoring window was found.

contracts.label: SOA schedule

contracts.value: Tactile stimulus: Two DS7A Digitimer constant-current stimulators delivered weak target and strong nontarget electrical stimuli through Neuroline electrodes on the upper side of the right index finger; intensities were calibrated to about 90% and 100% perception.
contracts.pageOrSection: PDF p.3, Procedure and Materials
contracts.evidenceNote: Device, site, target/nontarget role, and perceptual calibration are reported; pulse duration/current are not.
